correctness.rationale: Affine full-branch uniformity gives the exact Markov process, with rational branch enumeration checked for 101 blocks. Detailed balance gives an explicitly invariant sigma-finite density. Equal up and down jumps give exact finite gambler-ruin harmonic functions and recurrence; divergence of the unique reversible mass yields infinite-mean returns. Elementary renewal truncation proves zero finite-block occupation frequency; continuity and compactification imply weak empirical convergence to delta at the fixed endpoint. Regenerative cylinder hits prove density, and invariance excludes all absolutely continuous invariant probabilities. The infinite conclusions use these proofs, not finite tests.
